The Court made the following:
 2  THE HONOURABLE DR JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA  CRIMINAL PETITION NO: 3148/2022 ORDER:
The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, "Cr.P.C.")
has been filed by the Petitioner/ Accused, seeking quashment of the proceedings pending against her in FIR.No.97 of 2022 of Dargamitta P.S., SPSR Nellore District registered for the offence Sravanthi Reddy Medasani vs The State Of Ap on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101669310/

sentences.text: Heard Sri K. Jyothi Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. K. Priyanka Lakshmi,
Assistant Public Prosecutor on behalf of the State is in attendance.

3. When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that, in this case charge sheet is filed, as such, they intend to withdraw the petition with a liberty to challenge the charge sheet.
4.
Recording the said submission, this Criminal Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to challenge the charge sheet if so advised.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
